title: ee.agentsmd.export.v1
description: AGENTS.md bridge export report (ADR 0065 §5). Emitted under data by `ee export agentsmd`. The export renders the primer rules+warnings sections into a marker-delimited managed block; it never edits outside its markers, backs up the prior content before mutating, and refuses a hand-edited block without --force-managed-block. Deterministic: no wall-clock timestamps, no absolute paths, no binary version.

status.description: ok for a completed run (including no-op re-exports); file_missing when the target is absent and --create was not passed; refused_unmanaged_edit when the managed block was hand-edited and --force-managed-block was not passed.

file.description: Workspace-relative bridge target path (AGENTS.md by default).

dbGeneration.description: Workspace DB generation stamped on the managed-block begin marker.

dryRun.description: true previews the managed-block diff and writes nothing.

created.description: true when the run materialized a new file (--create).

changed.description: true when the managed block differs from what is (or would be) on disk; an idempotent re-export reports false.

backupPath.description: Workspace-relative .ee-backup sibling written before mutation; null for dry runs, no-ops, refusals, and fresh creates.

blockHash.description: Content hash of the rendered managed-block body, recorded on the begin marker for hand-edit detection.

redactionSkipped.description: Primer redaction skip count carried through for honesty (skipped, never leaked).

diff.description: Dry-run block replacement preview (removed lines prefixed '- ', added lines prefixed '+ '); null otherwise.

degraded.description: Standard ee.response.v2 degraded entries (agentsmd_file_missing, agentsmd_markers_missing, agentsmd_unmanaged_edit_detected).
